Copies the rule verbatim. Ask whether two colleagues who want to read and then create an exercise will need the same access.
Several abstract administrative expressions exceed A2. Simplify „funkcji użytkownika” and „ogólnodostępne treści” in surrounding prose; the noun phrase about paid textbooks is unnecessarily indirect.

Nominalizations and participles make the expository sections dense for A2. Replace „szkoła korzystająca z odpowiedniego wsparcia” with a finite clause. „Lista zakupów nie jest wyłącznie decyzją” is awkward; write „O zakupach decyduje więc więcej niż jedna osoba”.
Direct restatement. Give a sample of her notes from two chapters and ask which chapter she would review first.
Direct retrieval even for Emilia specifically. Ask which of several planned errands she could combine with her next shop.

The shopping sequence is accessible but „opakowaniu objętym tym systemem” and „zasadami dotyczącymi odpadów” are dense at A2. Prefer „liczby opakowań” for countable packages and „ponownie wykorzystać surowce” for the final clause.
All actions explicitly listed and unsafe distractors are self-evident. Infer his likely next step after completing the loan using his stated goal.

Repeated abstract legal vocabulary, passive meanings and long nominal chains exceed independent A2 reading. Introduce the term using a concrete situation. For idiomatic bank language prefer „umowę pożyczki” or „wziąć pożyczkę”.
